note: Alberta Parks campground in a bend of the Pembina River at Entwistle, in six loops of treed and open grass sites; some sites are close to the river. Trails link the loops to the shower house, beach and day use; a popular river-tubing take-out. Water is seasonal (mid-May on, weather permitting): bring your own in the shoulder season. --Claude
